authorization.scope: Open calendar 2024 once for Milestone 6 chronological validation of the unchanged frozen selector.
authorization.verbatim: Proceed to Milestone 6 under the existing research contract. Open calendar 2024 once and apply UNIVERSAL_ZN_4H_SIGN_V0_1 unchanged, using the frozen execution, data policy, and pass/reject gates. Do not retune the rule, add variables, optimize execution, or inspect 2025. Record an honest pass or rejection and stop after completing Milestone 6.

bootstrap.confidence_interval: Type-7 2.5 and 97.5 percent quantiles of the bootstrapped mean net return
bootstrap.seed: First eight bytes of SHA-256(validation manifest hash + vertical bar + session code + vertical bar + selector code)
bootstrap.verdict_role: Diagnostic only; the interval is reported but is not an adjustable pass threshold.

chronological_halves.assignment: Within each session, sort every eligible 2024 SESSION_CASE by decision_at then case_id. The first floor(N/2) cases are EARLY and the remaining cases are LATE. Assign halves before removing NO_BIAS cases.

cross_market_join.availability_rule: CROSS_MARKET_SNAPSHOT available_at must be no later than the SESSION_CASE decision_at.
cross_market_join.identity_rule: SESSION_CASE decision_state.cross_market_snapshot_id must match the joined CROSS_MARKET_SNAPSHOT record_id.
cross_market_join.point_in_time_rule: CROSS_MARKET_SNAPSHOT as_of must equal SESSION_CASE decision_at.
cross_market_join.ready_rule: The ZN instrument and 4_HOURS change must both have status READY; otherwise the feature is UNKNOWN.
cross_market_join.roll_rule: A CONTINUOUS_CONTRACT_ROLL change remains UNKNOWN and produces NO_BIAS.
cross_market_join.source_key: cross snapshot record_id + instrument + horizon + ZN source_record_key

case_materialization.locked_holdout_rule: Reject any calendar-2025 source row before JSON deserialization.

gates.pass_condition: Every joined session, cross-market feature, and selected fixed-execution outcome satisfies record hashes, lineage, availability, decision-clock, and calendar boundaries.
Each session has at least 100 directional selector cases.
Each session has at least 40 POSITIVE-to-LONG cases and at least 40 NEGATIVE-to-SHORT cases.
Each session and each directional state spans at least 20 distinct ISO-week clusters.
Each session selector has mean net return above zero after frozen 1.0x costs.
Each session selector has profit factor strictly above one after frozen 1.0x costs.
For each session, selector mean net return is strictly above the larger same-period mean net return of ALWAYS_LONG and ALWAYS_SHORT.
Within each session, POSITIVE-to-LONG and NEGATIVE-to-SHORT cells each have mean net return above zero after frozen 1.0x costs.
Within each session, both EARLY and LATE selector halves have mean net return above zero after frozen 1.0x costs.
Each session selector has mean net P&L above zero after 1.5x spread, slippage, and commission costs.

gate_evaluation.rejection_policy: If any gate fails, reject UNIVERSAL_ZN_4H_SIGN_V0_1. Calendar 2024 cannot be used to rename, retune, replace, or add a gate to this candidate.
gate_evaluation.session_baseline_selection: For each session, compare against max(ALWAYS_LONG mean net return, ALWAYS_SHORT mean net return) using the same calendar-2024 cases and frozen 1.0x execution.

output_policy.decision_records: One immutable validation decision for every 2024 SESSION_CASE, including NO_BIAS.
output_policy.metric_units: USD per fixed one-ounce position and basis points of entry notional.
